messages:
maria_sales: POC for HelixSoft — Dedicated GPU pool in ap-southeast1 not finishing provisioning. Stuck at "allocating" for ~12m. Customer waiting, any ideas?
jamal_eng: can you paste the reservation id and region/az?
maia_sales: typo — it's maria_sales. resv id: resv-8f3b22, requested zones: [ap-southeast1-a].
nina_cs: customer reported error in UI: "Provision failed: affinity mismatch". Screenshot incoming.
sanjay_infra: seeing cloud-provider errors for that resv id: 429 rate_limited on create requests then a partial failure: 
```
ERROR: failed to allocate nodes: AZ affinity mismatch, available zones=[ap-southeast1-b, ap-southeast1-c]
HTTP 429: QuotaExceeded: request_rate_exceeded
```
jamal_eng: 429 from provider + AZ mismatch — two separate issues. Did we already pin AZ in their reservation config?
maria_sales: yes, sales set az_affinity=ap-southeast1-a to satisfy latency req. Customer explicitly asked for a single AZ for compliance.
alice_sre: single-AZ + limited provider capacity = brittle. We should fallback to our reserved fallback policy that allows AZ relax for POC; but customer compliance might block.
nina_cs: customer brief says single-AZ required for now, but they said they can accept a short maintenance window to switch AZ if we document controls. Could we get a one-off exception?
sanjay_infra: quick checklist: 1) verify cloud quota for GPUs in requested AZ 2) check internal rate limiter (we throttle provisioning bursts) 3) ensure reservation config not requesting more GPUs than allocated commit
jamal_eng: running internal diagnostic: `./resvctl status resv-8f3b22 --verbose` — output:
```
resv-8f3b22: state=allocating
requested: gpus=8, azs=[ap-southeast1-a]
provider: capacity_check=failed (0 avail in ap-southeast1-a), provider_rate_limit=429
fallback_policy: disabled (strict_az=true)
```
maia_sales: (again, that's maria_sales :))
alice_sre: ok. Proposed path: temporarily enable fallback AZ for this resv, retry provisioning, then document controls and get customer signoff. Also escalate to cloud partner for quota bump in ap-southeast1-a.
maria_sales: customer already expects POC today. If we change AZ we must note possible IP/latency differences. They agreed to short maintenance window earlier.
jamal_eng: I can enable fallback_policy for that resv now and requeue. Adding safe rollback: if cloud returns 500 or >5% error we cancel.
sanjay_infra: also add exponential backoff to provider API calls — current burst likely hit their rate limiter. I'll bump our internal rate limit for this account token for 2 minutes.
deploy-bot: [provisioning] trigger: resv-8f3b22 retry (actor=jamal_eng)
(deploy-bot): provisioning attempts: 1 -> 2, target_azs=[ap-southeast1-a,ap-southeast1-b]
jamal_eng: retry kicked off. watching logs.
(deploy-bot): provisioning log: provider response -> allocated nodes in ap-southeast1-b, 8 gpus attached.
maria_sales: customer confirmed pool is now available in their console. Happy path.
nina_cs: will send customer short note: explain we temporarily relaxed AZ affinity due to provider capacity + rate limits, outline mitigation and offer a scheduled migration back when we secure capacity in ap-southeast1-a.
alice_sre: follow-ups: 1) create ticket to request quota bump with cloud partner 2) add a validation to UI that warns about single-AZ fragility for POCs 3) doc change: recommended fallback policy for sales-driven POCs.
sanjay_infra: created partner-ticket #CP-5421 for quota + flagged for priority.
jamal_eng: adding a small automation PR to enable transient fallback and controlled backoff for sales POCs — will link PR in thread.
maria_sales: thanks all. Please add estimated time to migrate back to ap-southeast1-a so I can share with the customer.
alice_sre: estimate: 48-72h after quota confirmed. :thumbsup:
jamal_eng: PR link: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/resvctl/pulls/482 — contains opt-in flag `--allow-temporary-az-relax`
maia_sales: (seriously maria this time) closing loop: customer accepted short AZ change, POC green. Closing thread after docs updated. :white_check_mark:
